context7.name: Context7 文档检索
context7.summary: 按库名检索最新版本的文档与代码示例，覆盖 React、Next.js、Supabase 等数千个开源库，避免模型凭记忆写过期 API。
context7.summary_en: Version-accurate docs and snippets for thousands of libraries, so the model stops writing APIs from memory.

deepwiki.name: DeepWiki 仓库问答
deepwiki.summary: 把任意 GitHub 仓库变成可问答的文档站，适合快速摸清陌生项目的目录结构与模块职责。
deepwiki.summary_en: Turns any GitHub repository into a documentation site you can question: structure, modules, responsibilities.

cloudflare_docs.name: Cloudflare 文档
cloudflare_docs.summary: 检索 Workers、Pages、R2、D1 等产品的官方文档与迁移指南。
cloudflare_docs.summary_en: Search the official docs and migration guides for Workers, Pages, R2 and D1.

microsoft_learn.name: Microsoft Learn
microsoft_learn.summary: 检索微软与 Azure 的官方文档、教程和可运行的代码示例。
microsoft_learn.summary_en: Microsoft and Azure documentation, tutorials and runnable code samples.

aws_docs.name: AWS 文档
aws_docs.summary: 查询 AWS 服务文档、区域可用性与功能清单，回答部署前的地域与配额问题。
aws_docs.summary_en: AWS service docs, regional availability and feature lists.

exa.name: Exa 语义搜索
exa.summary: 面向语义的网页搜索与正文抓取，返回可阅读的链接摘要。不填密钥也能用，但额度有限。
exa.summary_en: Semantic web search and page fetching. Works without a key on a limited quota.

firecrawl.name: Firecrawl 网页抓取
firecrawl.summary: 抓取网页正文、批量爬取站点并转成 Markdown，适合把资料整理进工作区。不填密钥也能用，但额度有限。
firecrawl.summary_en: Scrape pages, crawl sites and return Markdown. Works without a key on a limited quota.

bocha.name: 博查 AI 搜索
bocha.summary: 面向中文互联网的网页搜索与 AI 摘要，结果带来源，适合查国内资讯与政策原文。
bocha.summary_en: Chinese-language web search with AI summaries and sources.

tavily.name: Tavily 搜索
tavily.summary: 为智能体设计的搜索接口，返回摘要与来源链接，适合做事实核对和资料汇总。
tavily.summary_en: A search API built for agents: summaries plus source links.

amap.name: 高德地图
amap.summary: 地理编码、POI 搜索、路径规划与天气，国内出行与到店场景覆盖最全。
amap.summary_en: Geocoding, POI search, routing and weather for travel in mainland China.

qqmap.name: 腾讯位置服务
qqmap.summary: 地址解析、地点搜索、周边检索与驾车、步行路线规划。
qqmap.summary_en: Address parsing, place search, nearby search and driving or walking routes.

baidu_map.name: 百度地图
baidu_map.summary: 逆地理编码、地点检索、路线规划等 10 个地图工具，与高德互为备份。
baidu_map.summary_en: Reverse geocoding, place search and routing, ten map tools in all.

tianyancha.name: 天眼查企业数据
tianyancha.summary: 企业工商信息、股东与风险查询，适合做尽调与供应商核查。
tianyancha.summary_en: Company registration, shareholders and risk records for due diligence.

workspace.name: 本地工具服务
workspace.summary: 随项目启动的示例 MCP 服务，可读写工作区文件。属于本机回环地址，生产部署不要打开。
workspace.summary_en: The sample MCP service that ships with this repository. Loopback only; never enable in production.
